short_description.id: Aatxe, "banteng muda", adalah roh gua Basque berwujud banteng merah yang keluar pada malam badai untuk menghukum penjahat, sebagai wakil dewi Mari.
short_description.en: Aatxe, 'young bull', is a Basque cave spirit in the form of a red bull that comes out on stormy nights to punish criminals, as the goddess Mari's agent.

long_description.id: Aatxe atau Aatxegorri, "banteng muda (merah)", adalah roh gua Basque yang berwujud banteng merah tetapi dapat menjadi manusia, sapi, atau anak sapi. Pada malam badai ia keluar dari sarangnya, menyerang penjahat, dan menurut artikel bahasa Jerman menggiring penduduk ke dalam rumah. Ia diduga wakil atau pelaksana kehendak dewi Mari, dan kadang disebut Etsai.
long_description.en: Aatxe or Aatxegorri, 'young (red) bull', is a Basque cave spirit in the form of a red bull who can become a man, cow or calf. On stormy nights he leaves his lair and attacks criminals, and per the German article drives people indoors. He is thought to be the goddess Mari's agent or enforcer, and is sometimes called Etsai.

long_description.id: Gua-gua yang dikaitkan dengannya, seperti Isturits dan Sare, memuat lukisan banteng Paleolitik, sehingga mitos ini mungkin sangat tua. Artikel bahasa Prancis menyebut Aatxe anak Behigorri, sapi merah.
long_description.en: Caves linked with him, such as Isturits and Sare, hold Palaeolithic bull paintings, so the myth may be very old. The French article calls Aatxe the young of Behigorri, the red cow.

note.en: The goddess he represents.
His mother per the French article.

claims.quote: Aatxe (pronounced [a.atʃe]; a contraction of aratxe) is a spirit in the folk mythology of the Basque people. His name is literally translated as "Young Bull", and he is sometimes known as Etsai.

statement.id: Aatxe (kependekan dari aratxe) adalah roh dalam mitologi rakyat Basque; namanya berarti "banteng muda", dan kadang ia disebut Etsai.
statement.en: Aatxe (a contraction of aratxe) is a spirit of Basque folk mythology; his name means 'young bull', and he is sometimes called Etsai.

claims.quote: He is a cave-dwelling spirit who adopts the form of a young red bull, but being a shapeshifter, sometimes takes the shape of a man. Aatxe is also described as a shapeshifter that may appear not only as a bull but also as a cow or calf.

statement.id: Ia roh penghuni gua yang berwujud banteng muda merah, tetapi sebagai pengubah wujud kadang menjadi manusia, sapi, atau anak sapi.
statement.en: He is a cave-dwelling spirit in the form of a young red bull, but as a shapeshifter sometimes becomes a man, a cow or a calf.

claims.quote: At night, more so in stormy weather, he arises from the hollow which is his lair. He attacks criminals and other malevolent people.

statement.id: Pada malam hari, terutama saat badai, ia keluar dari lubang sarangnya dan menyerang penjahat serta orang jahat lain.
statement.en: At night, especially in storms, he comes out of his lair and attacks criminals and other wicked people.

claims.quote: He is theorized to be a representative of the goddess Mari, or may be an enforcer of her will, punishing people who cheat her. Another name for him is Aatxegorri which means "young red bull".

statement.id: Ia diduga wakil dewi Mari atau pelaksana kehendaknya yang menghukum orang yang menipunya; nama lainnya Aatxegorri, "banteng muda merah".
statement.en: He is thought to represent the goddess Mari or enforce her will, punishing those who cheat her; another name is Aatxegorri, 'young red bull'.

claims.quote: It is believed Aatxe inhabited caves and hollows; in many (Isturits, Sare, Errenteria, among others) engravings and paintings depicting aurochs, bulls, and oxen have been found; which implies that this Basque myth has its origins in the Paleolithic.

statement.id: Di banyak gua yang dihuni Aatxe, seperti Isturits, Sare, dan Errenteria, ditemukan ukiran dan lukisan aurochs, banteng, dan lembu, yang menunjukkan mitos ini berakar pada zaman Paleolitik.
statement.en: In many caves Aatxe was thought to inhabit, such as Isturits, Sare and Errenteria, engravings and paintings of aurochs, bulls and oxen have been found, implying the myth goes back to the Palaeolithic.

short_description.id: Asena adalah serigala betina dalam mitos pendirian bangsa Göktürk, leluhur klan Ashina yang memerintah kekaisaran Turkik.
short_description.en: Asena is the she-wolf of the Göktürk foundation myth, ancestress of the Ashina clan that ruled the Turkic empires.

long_description.id: Asena adalah serigala betina dalam mitos pendirian bangsa Göktürk. Ia menemukan dan merawat seorang anak yang selamat dari pertempuran, lalu, setelah hamil, menyeberangi Laut Barat menuju gua dekat pegunungan Qocho dan melahirkan sepuluh anak setengah serigala setengah manusia. Salah satunya, Yizhi Nishidu, mendirikan klan Ashina yang memerintah Göktürk dan kekaisaran Turkik lainnya.
long_description.en: Asena is the she-wolf of the Göktürk foundation myth. She finds and nurses a boy who survived a battle, then, pregnant, crosses the Western Sea to a cave near the Qocho mountains and bears ten half-wolf, half-human sons. One of them, Yizhi Nishidu, founds the Ashina clan that ruled the Göktürk and other Turkic empires.

long_description.id: Catatan tertua legenda ini ada dalam kronik Dinasti Zhou Utara dari pertengahan abad keenam, dan hampir semua kisah Tiongkok tentang asal-usul bangsa Turk memberi peran khusus kepada serigala betina. Pada 1930-an, nasionalisme Turki menghidupkan kembali pemujaan tokoh seperti Asena dan Bozkurt.
long_description.en: The oldest record of the legend is in the Northern Zhou chronicles of the mid-sixth century, and almost every Chinese account of the Turks' descent gives a she-wolf a special role. In the 1930s Turkish nationalism revived reverence for figures such as Asena and Bozkurt.

statement.en: The Cheval Gauvin ('Gauvin horse') is a legendary evil horse of Franche-Comté, France, and the Jura Mountains of Switzerland, which wanders along streams, through forests and graveyards and tries to kill its riders by drowning them or throwing them into an abyss.

claims.quote: In Switzerland, the horse gallops through villages and abducts young girls. Several legends are attached to it, one of which makes it the mount of the medieval lord Amauri III de Joux.

statement.en: In Switzerland the horse gallops through villages and carries off young girls; one legend makes it the mount of the medieval lord Amauri III de Joux.

claims.quote: A harbinger of death, the Gauvin horse seems to have acted as a bogeyman for children. Perhaps the result of a goblin's transformation (a hobgoblin), he joins a large number of legendary Jura horses.

statement.id: Sebagai pertanda kematian, kuda Gauvin tampaknya juga momok penakut anak; mungkin jelmaan peri usil, ia termasuk banyak kuda legendaris Jura.
statement.en: A harbinger of death, the Gauvin horse seems to have served as a children's bogeyman; perhaps a transformed goblin, it is one of many legendary Jura horses.

claims.quote: The Gauvin horse bears the same name as a famous knight of the Round Table, nephew of King Arthur.

short_description.id: Cheval Mallet adalah kuda jahat dari Vendée dan Pays de Retz yang muncul pada malam hari, menggoda pelancong lelah untuk menungganginya, lalu membawa mereka pergi selamanya.
short_description.en: The Cheval Mallet is an evil horse of the Vendée and Pays de Retz that appears at night, tempts weary travellers to ride it, and carries them off for good.

long_description.id: Cheval Mallet adalah kuda dongeng yang jahat dari Vendée, Poitou, dan Pays de Retz. Pada malam hari ia muncul sebagai kuda putih atau hitam lengkap dengan pelana, menggoda pelancong yang lelah; yang naik tidak pernah kembali kecuali membawa ongkos atau medali Santo Benediktus. Ia dianggap alat Iblis, mungkin terkait Sleipnir dan Perburuan Liar, dan mirip Lou Drapé.
long_description.en: The Cheval Mallet is a fabulous evil horse of the Vendée, Poitou and the Pays de Retz. At night it appears as a saddled white or black horse tempting weary travellers; riders never return unless they carry the fare or a St Benedict medal. It is seen as the Devil's tool, perhaps linked to Sleipnir and the Wild Hunt, and resembles Lou Drapé.

long_description.id: Namanya mungkin dari kata Kelt untuk peti. Di Saint-Lumine-de-Coutais pernah ada pesta Kuda Merlet dengan pemeran berkostum kuda di sekitar pohon ek, yang dilarang pada 1791.
long_description.en: Its name may come from a Celtic word for a trunk. Saint-Lumine-de-Coutais once held a Horse Merlet feast with an actor dressed as a horse around an oak, banned in 1791.

who.en: An evil horse that tempts travellers.

description.id: Penunggang yang membawa ongkos perjalanan atau medali Santo Benediktus selamat.
description.en: Riders with the fare or a St Benedict medal are safe.

note.en: A similar fabulous horse.

claims.quote: The Cheval Mallet (or Malet, meaning Mallet Horse) describes a fabulous and evil horse mentioned in folklore around the French Vendée, Poitou, and more frequently in the Pays de Retz, near Lac de Grand Lieu.

statement.id: Cheval Mallet atau Malet adalah kuda dongeng yang jahat dalam cerita rakyat Vendée, Poitou, dan terutama Pays de Retz dekat Danau Grand-Lieu, Prancis.
statement.en: The Cheval Mallet or Malet is a fabulous evil horse of the folklore of the Vendée, Poitou and especially the Pays de Retz near Lac de Grand-Lieu, France.

claims.quote: It was supposed to appear at night (sometimes specifically in the middle of the night) as a beautiful white or black horse, saddled and bridled, and tempt travelers who were exhausted from a long journey. Unwary travelers who accepted a ride would never be seen again, unless they had the price of travel or a protection spell, such as a medal of St. Benedict.

statement.id: Ia muncul pada malam hari sebagai kuda putih atau hitam yang indah, lengkap dengan pelana dan tali kekang, menggoda pelancong yang kelelahan; yang naik tidak pernah terlihat lagi kecuali membawa ongkos perjalanan atau jimat seperti medali Santo Benediktus.
statement.en: It appeared at night as a beautiful white or black horse, saddled and bridled, tempting exhausted travellers; those who rode it were never seen again unless they carried the fare or a protective charm such as a St Benedict medal.

claims.quote: There was also a feast known as Horse Merlette, Merlet or Mallet in the town of Saint-Lumine-de-Coutais. It was a celebration of renewal and featured several actors around one oak, one disguised as a horse. It was opposed by the ecclesiastical authorities and banned in 1791.

statement.id: Di Saint-Lumine-de-Coutais ada pesta Kuda Merlette, Merlet, atau Mallet, perayaan pembaruan dengan para pemeran di sekitar pohon ek, salah satunya berkostum kuda; pesta itu ditentang gereja dan dilarang pada 1791.
statement.en: Saint-Lumine-de-Coutais held a feast of the Horse Merlette, Merlet or Mallet, a renewal festival with actors around an oak, one dressed as a horse; the Church opposed it and it was banned in 1791.

claims.quote: Le cheval Mallet est vu comme un instrument du Diable, voire une forme de Satan lui-même. Peut-être issu de Sleipnir et de la chasse sauvage, sa légende est très semblable à celle d'autres chevaux fabuleux tels que lou drapé ou la blanque jument.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, ia dianggap alat Iblis atau wujud Setan sendiri, mungkin berasal dari Sleipnir dan Perburuan Liar, dan legendanya mirip kuda dongeng lain seperti Lou Drapé dan blanque jument.
statement.en: According to the French article it is seen as the Devil's instrument or Satan himself, perhaps derived from Sleipnir and the Wild Hunt, and its legend is like those of other fabulous horses such as Lou Drapé or the blanque jument.

claims.quote: Le nom de « Mallet », et par corruption « Merlet », pourrait être issu de mail qui signifie « malle » ou « valise » dans les anciennes langues celtiques.

statement.id: Nama Mallet, yang berubah menjadi Merlet, mungkin dari kata mail, "peti" atau "koper", dalam bahasa Kelt kuno.
statement.en: The name Mallet, corrupted to Merlet, may come from mail, 'trunk' or 'case', in old Celtic languages.

short_description.id: Demon Cat adalah hantu kucing dalam cerita rakyat Amerika yang konon menghantui Gedung Kapitol dan Gedung Putih di Washington, D.C.
short_description.en: The Demon Cat is a ghost cat of American folklore said to haunt the Capitol and the White House in Washington, D.C.

long_description.id: Demon Cat adalah hantu kucing yang konon menghantui gedung-gedung pemerintahan di Washington, D.C., terutama Gedung Putih dan Gedung Kapitol. Kisahnya bermula dari kucing-kucing yang dibawa ke terowongan bawah tanah Kapitol untuk memburu tikus; menurut legenda, salah satunya tidak pernah pergi meski sudah mati.
long_description.en: The Demon Cat is a ghost cat said to haunt government buildings in Washington, D.C., especially the White House and the Capitol. The story starts with cats brought into the Capitol's basement tunnels to hunt rats; legend says one of them never left, even after death.

long_description.id: Kucing ini digambarkan sebagai kucing hitam atau belang seukuran kucing rumah, tetapi saksi melaporkan ia membesar hingga seukuran harimau raksasa atau gajah. Ia dipercaya muncul menjelang pemilihan presiden dan tragedi, termasuk sebelum pembunuhan John Kennedy dan Abraham Lincoln serta krisis Wall Street 1929. Pada tahun 1890-an ia konon lenyap saat ditembaki penjaga Capitol Hill.
long_description.en: The cat is described as a black or tabby house-sized cat, but witnesses say it swells to the size of a giant tiger or an elephant. It is believed to appear before presidential elections and tragedies, including the assassinations of John Kennedy and Abraham Lincoln and the 1929 Wall Street crash. In the 1890s it reportedly vanished when Capitol Hill guards shot at it.

long_description.id: Steve Livengood dari U.S. Capitol Historical Society menduga legenda ini berawal dari penjaga yang mabuk, yang dijilat kucing Kapitol lalu mengira kucing itu raksasa.
long_description.en: Steve Livengood of the U.S. Capitol Historical Society suggests the legend began with a drunken guard who was licked by a Capitol cat and took it for a giant.

short_description.id: Gaueko adalah roh malam dalam mitologi Basque yang melarang manusia bekerja di luar rumah pada malam hari dan menghukum orang yang pamer tidak takut gelap.
short_description.en: Gaueko is the spirit of the night in Basque mythology who forbids people to work outside at night and punishes those who boast of not fearing the dark.

long_description.id: Gaueko, "yang dari malam", adalah roh atau dewa malam Basque yang menguasai waktu dari tengah malam sampai kokok ayam pertama. Ia melarang manusia meninggalkan rumah dan bekerja di luar pada malam hari, dan menghukum orang yang pamer keberanian; pelanggar bisa diculik atau hilang. Ia hadir sebagai embusan angin sambil mengucapkan "malam untuk Gaueko, siang untuk yang siang".
long_description.en: Gaueko, 'of the night', is the Basque spirit or god of the night who rules from midnight to the first cockcrow. He forbids people to leave home and work outside at night and punishes boasters; transgressors may be abducted or vanish. He makes himself felt as a gust of wind, saying 'the night for Gaueko, the day for the day'.

long_description.id: Ia dianggap setan atau dewa pagan, dan muncul tak terlihat, sebagai serigala hitam yang kadang berdiri, sapi, burung hantu, domba, atau monster. Seperti Mari ia dapat berubah wujud dan menguasai unsur alam, tetapi tak berdaya melawannya; ketika manusia meminta tolong, Mari memberi cahaya bulan, Ilargi.
long_description.en: He is seen as a devil or pagan god, appearing invisibly or as a black wolf sometimes standing upright, a cow, owl, sheep or monster. Like Mari he can change shape and command the elements, but he is powerless against her; when people asked for help, Mari gave them the light of the moon, Ilargi.

short_description.id: Ahriman adalah roh jahat dalam tradisi Iran, Zoroastrianisme, dan Zurvanisme, yang dikaitkan dengan kegelapan serta kekacauan.
short_description.en: Ahriman is an evil spirit in Iranian tradition, Zoroastrianism, and Zurvanism, associated with darkness and chaos.

long_description.id: Ahriman adalah roh jahat dalam tradisi Iran, Zoroastrianisme, dan Zurvanisme, yang dikaitkan dengan kegelapan serta kekacauan. Angra Mainyu menjadi nama lain Ahriman.
long_description.en: Ahriman is an evil spirit in Iranian tradition, Zoroastrianism, and Zurvanism, associated with darkness and chaos. Angra Mainyu is another name for Ahriman.

long_description.id: Sumber menjelaskan Ahriman berlawanan dengan Spenta Mainyu dan Ahura Mazda. Dalam Zurvanisme, Zurvan melahirkan Ahura Mazda dan Ahriman. Dalam uraian Hinnells yang dikutip, Ahriman mendiami jurang kegelapan tanpa akhir di utara. Ahriman dapat berubah bentuk menjadi kadal, ular, atau pemuda. Tujuan Ahriman dijelaskan sebagai menghancurkan ciptaan Ahura Mazda. Ahriman membalas kehidupan dengan kematian dan kesehatan dengan penyakit. Kisah yang dibahas melibatkan Gavaevodta, Banteng Primordial. Gayomartan juga dibunuh oleh Ahriman dalam kisah itu. Ahriman membisikkan kebohongan kepada pasangan manusia pertama bahwa dialah pencipta mereka. Nama Avestanya adalah Angra Mainyu. Dalam Gatha, angra mainyu belum diperlakukan sebagai nama diri. Pembacaan Ahuna Vairya oleh Ahura Mazda disebut membuat Angra Mainyu terpana. Pengantar terjemahan Vendidad I menjelaskan enam belas negeri ciptaan Ahura Mazda dan wabah tandingannya dari Angra Mainyu.
long_description.en: The source places Ahriman in opposition to Spenta Mainyu and Ahura Mazda. In Zurvanism, Zurvan gives birth to Ahura Mazda and Ahriman. In the quoted account by Hinnells, Ahriman inhabits an abyss of endless northern darkness. Ahriman can change form into a lizard, snake, or young man. Ahriman’s aim is described as destroying Ahura Mazda’s creation. Ahriman counters life with death and health with disease. The account includes Gavaevodta, the Primordial Bull. Gayomartan is also killed by Ahriman in that account. Ahriman lies to the first human couple by claiming to be their creator. His Avestan name is Angra Mainyu. In the Gathas, angra mainyu is not yet a proper name. Angra Mainyu falls into a stupor when Ahura Mazda recites Ahuna Vairya. The introduction to Vendidad I describes sixteen lands created by Ahura Mazda and opposing plagues created by Angra Mainyu.

short_description.id: Akerbeltz, "kambing jantan hitam", adalah roh Basque pelindung ternak yang tinggal di dalam tanah, yang pada masa perburuan penyihir disamakan dengan setan pemimpin akelarre.
short_description.en: Akerbeltz, 'black billy goat', is a Basque spirit who guards livestock and lives inside the earth, equated during the witch hunts with the devil presiding over the akelarre.

long_description.id: Akerbeltz atau Aker, "kambing jantan hitam", adalah roh Basque yang tinggal di dalam tanah dan memiliki banyak peri sebagai pelayan. Ia dianggap dewa kuno pelindung hewan dan rumah yang dapat menyembuhkan ternak dan melambangkan kesuburan, sehingga banyak keluarga Basque memelihara kambing jantan hitam di kandang. Ia juga dapat menimbulkan badai, dan orang Pyrenees percaya janggut kambing dipakai untuk membuat hujan es.
long_description.en: Akerbeltz or Aker, 'black billy goat', is a Basque spirit who lives inside the earth with many elves as servants. He is seen as an ancient protector of animals and houses who heals livestock and embodies fertility, so many Basque families kept a black billy goat in the stable. He can also raise storms, and Pyrenean people believed a goat's beard was taken to make hail.

long_description.id: Dalam agama Kristen ia disamakan dengan setan pemimpin akelarre, "padang kambing" tempat sabat penyihir. Inkuisitor Pierre de Lancre mencatat kesaksian bahwa ia berwajah dua dan memimpin parodi misa dengan persembahan telur, roti, dan uang; ia konon tinggal di gua Zugarramurdi. Namanya mirip dewa Mesir Aker, tetapi kaitannya tidak pasti.
long_description.en: Christianity identified him with the devil presiding over the akelarre, the 'goat's meadow' of the witches' sabbath. The inquisitor Pierre de Lancre recorded testimony that he had two faces and held a parody mass with offerings of eggs, bread and money; he was said to dwell in the Zugarramurdi caves. His name resembles the Egyptian god Aker, though any link is uncertain.

short_description.id: Moddey Dhoo ("anjing hitam" dalam bahasa Manx) adalah anjing hitam hantu dalam folklor Manx yang konon menghantui Kastel Peel di Pulau Man.
short_description.en: The Moddey Dhoo ('black dog' in Manx) is a phantom black dog of Manx folklore said to haunt Peel Castle on the Isle of Man.

long_description.id: Moddey Dhoo, yang dalam bahasa Manx berarti "anjing hitam", adalah anjing hantu hitam folklor Manx yang konon menghantui Kastel Peel (Peel Castle) di pesisir barat Pulau Man. Sumber abad ke-18 yang berpengaruh salah menuliskannya menjadi Mauthe Doog. Penyair dan topografer Inggris George Waldron, satu-satunya sumber tertulis utama, menggambarkannya sebagai anjing spaniel hitam besar berbulu keriting yang berbaring di depan perapian ruang jaga di hadapan para prajurit.
long_description.en: The Moddey Dhoo, Manx for 'black dog', is a phantom black hound of Manx folklore reputed to haunt Peel Castle on the Isle of Man's west coast. An influential 18th-century source miswrote the name as Mauthe Doog. The English topographer and poet George Waldron, the only firm written authority, pictured it as a big black spaniel with curly shaggy hair that lay before the guard-room fire in front of the soldiers.

long_description.id: Anjing itu datang dari sebuah lorong saat senja dan kembali ke sana saat fajar. Menurut Waldron, seorang penjaga yang mabuk nekat mengunci gerbang sendirian dan membawa kunci melalui lorong berhantu; ia kembali ketakutan, tak sanggup bercerita, dan mati tiga hari kemudian. Lorong itu lalu ditutup. Sir Walter Scott memperkenalkannya kepada dunia dalam Peveril of the Peak (1823). Artikel nl menyebut kejadian itu terjadi pada 1666 dan menyamakannya dengan yeth hound Devon dan gwyllgi Wales.
long_description.en: It came out of a passage at dusk and went back into it at dawn. Waldron says a drunken guard insisted on locking the gate alone and took the keys down the haunted passage; he came back terrified, unable to speak of what he saw, and died three days later, after which the passage was sealed. Sir Walter Scott brought the dog to wide notice in Peveril of the Peak (1823). The nl article dates the incident to 1666 and likens it to the yeth hound of Devon and the gwyllgi of Wales.

short_description.id: Boobrie adalah makhluk pengubah wujud dalam mitologi Skotlandia yang menghuni danau di pantai barat, biasanya berwujud burung air raksasa mirip kormoran.
short_description.en: The boobrie is a shapeshifting being of Scottish myth inhabiting the lochs of the west coast, usually in the form of a giant water bird like a cormorant.

long_description.id: Boobrie adalah makhluk mitologi pengubah wujud yang menghuni danau (loch) di pantai barat Skotlandia (Scotland). Ia biasanya tampak sebagai burung air raksasa mirip kormoran atau great northern diver, tetapi juga dapat menjelma menjadi makhluk mitos lain seperti banteng air. Umumnya jahat, boobrie memangsa ternak yang diangkut dengan kapal, terutama anak sapi, dan sangat gemar memakan berang-berang. Dalam wujud kuda air ia dapat berlari di atas permukaan danau seolah di tanah padat, dan pada musim panas kadang terlihat sebagai serangga besar yang mengisap darah kuda.
long_description.en: The boobrie is a shape-changing mythological being of the lochs along Scotland's west coast. Its usual guise is an enormous waterbird, much like a cormorant or a great northern diver, yet it may also appear as other mythical beasts such as a water bull. Generally malicious, it preys on livestock carried on ships, calves above all, and is very fond of eating otters. As a water horse it can gallop over a loch as if on firm ground, and in summer it is now and then seen as a big insect sucking horses' blood.

long_description.id: Folklorist Campbell of Islay menduga gambaran boobrie berasal dari penampakan great auk, dan suaranya yang melenguh seperti banteng mungkin berasal dari panggilan burung bittern. Nama boobrie mungkin dari boibhre, "pemberi sapi"; leksikografer Edward Dwelly mencatat tarbh-boidhre sebagai "monster, iblis" dan "dewa yang mampu berubah menjadi banyak wujud". Menurut artikel fr, tubuhnya berbintik putih, ia mampu melenguh, dan cukup besar untuk melahap domba dan sapi; ia juga dikatakan wujud jelmaan Each Uisge.
long_description.en: Folklorist Campbell of Islay suggested descriptions of the boobrie may come from sightings of the great auk, and its bull-like bellow may stem from the call of the bittern. The name may come from boibhre, 'cow giver'; the lexicographer Edward Dwelly glosses tarbh-boidhre as a monster or demon, a god able to take many shapes. According to the fr article its body is spotted with white, it can bellow, and it is big enough to devour sheep and cattle; it is also said to be a transformed shape of the Each Uisge.

did_you_know.en: As a water horse the boobrie can gallop across a loch as if on solid ground.

short_description.id: Ceffyl Dŵr adalah kuda air dalam cerita rakyat Wales, padanan kelpie Skotlandia, yang memikat pelancong untuk menungganginya lalu menjatuhkan mereka hingga tewas.
short_description.en: The ceffyl dŵr is a water horse of Welsh folklore, counterpart of the Scottish kelpie, that lures travellers to ride it and then drops them to their deaths.

long_description.id: Ceffyl Dŵr (juga ceffyl dwfr atau ceffyl-dŵr) adalah kuda air dalam cerita rakyat Wales (Welsh). Ia paling sering dianggap padanan kelpie Skotlandia (Scottish), tetapi juga dibandingkan dengan púca Irlandia (Irish), each uisge Irlandia dan Skotlandia, dan glaistyn Manx. Ia dikatakan terutama menghuni kolam gunung dan air terjun, meski juga sungai dan pantai. Ia diyakini roh yang berwujud kuda, biasanya kelabu atau hitam bersurai putih, kadang bercahaya atau bersayap, untuk memikat pelancong yang lengah agar menungganginya.
long_description.en: Welsh folklore tells of the ceffyl dŵr, also written ceffyl dwfr or ceffyl-dŵr, a horse of the waters. Usually it is matched with the Scottish kelpie, though it has also been compared with the Irish púca, the each uisge and the Manx glaistyn. It mostly haunts mountain pools and waterfalls, though rivers and seashores too. People took it for a spirit in horse shape, most often grey or black with a pale mane, at times shining or with wings, that tempted careless travellers to climb on.

long_description.id: Setelah ditunggangi, ia membawa penunggangnya sangat jauh dengan cepat atau terbang ke langit lalu menguap menjadi udara atau kabut, menjatuhkan penunggangnya hingga tewas. Wataknya berbeda menurut daerah: di Wales Utara sering dianggap jahat dengan mata menyala, sedangkan di Wales Selatan lebih positif, paling buruk pengganggu dan paling baik penolong pelancong yang lelah. Di beberapa daerah ia dapat berubah menjadi kambing yang menyeruduk, atau di Vale of Clwyd menjadi katak yang melompat ke punggung orang dan mencekik mereka. Menurut artikel de, namanya berarti "kuda air" (ceffyl "kuda", dŵr "air"), dan ia tidak sejahat kelpie atau each uisge.
long_description.en: Once mounted it either carries the rider a great distance at speed or soars into the sky and dissolves into air or mist, dropping the rider to death. Its temper varies by region: in North Wales it was often wicked, with fiery eyes, while in South Wales it was viewed more kindly, at worst a nuisance and at best a help to weary travellers. In some places it could become a goat that charged people, or in the Vale of Clwyd a frog that leapt onto people's backs and choked them. According to the de article its name means 'water horse' (ceffyl 'horse', dŵr 'water'), and it is less vicious than the kelpie or each uisge.

short_description.id: Arkan sonney ("landak keberuntungan") adalah sebutan Manx untuk landak sekaligus hewan peri berwujud babi putih yang membawa keberuntungan bagi yang menangkapnya.
short_description.en: Arkan sonney ('lucky urchin') is the Manx word for hedgehog and a fairy animal in the form of a white pig that brings luck to whoever catches it.

long_description.id: Arkan sonney (harfiah "landak keberuntungan" atau "babi kecil yang berlimpah") adalah sebutan Manx untuk landak. Arkan sonney juga sejenis hewan peri berwujud babi putih yang membawa keberuntungan bagi yang berhasil menangkapnya; bahkan sekadar melihat "babi keberuntungan" itu dianggap pertanda baik. Konon orang yang menangkapnya akan selalu menemukan koin perak di sakunya, tetapi menahannya terlalu lama akan mendatangkan sial.
long_description.en: Arkan sonney (literally 'lucky urchin' or 'plentiful little pig') is the Manx word for hedgehog. The arkan sonney is also a kind of fairy animal shaped like a white pig that brings good fortune to anyone who catches it; merely seeing the 'lucky piggy' was a good omen. Whoever caught one was said always to find a silver coin in his pocket, though keeping it too long brought bad luck.

long_description.id: Dalam Fairy Tales From the Isle of Man (1951) karya Dora Broome, babi putih itu bermata dan bertelinga merah, dan meski dapat mengubah ukurannya ia tak dapat mengubah wujudnya. Menurut artikel no, dalam cerita rakyat Manx ada makhluk seperti nisse atau elf yang tampak seperti landak bertelinga panjang; menangkapnya membawa keberuntungan, karena itu mereka disebut "babi keberuntungan", tetapi karena itu pula mereka menghindari manusia. Menurut artikel fr, dalam folklore Isle of Man arkan sonney berarti landak.
long_description.en: In Dora Broome's Fairy Tales From the Isle of Man (1951) the white pig has red eyes and ears, and though it can change its size it cannot change its shape. According to the no article Manx folk tales tell of a being like a nisse or elf that looks like a long-eared hedgehog; catching one brings luck, hence the name 'lucky pig', and for that very reason they shun people. According to the fr article, in Isle of Man folklore arkan sonney means a hedgehog.

short_description.id: Binatang Gévaudan adalah satu atau lebih binatang pemangsa manusia yang meneror Gévaudan, Prancis, pada 1764–1767, yang identitasnya masih diperdebatkan sampai kini.
short_description.en: The Beast of Gévaudan was one or more man-eating animals that terrorised Gévaudan, France, in 1764–1767, whose identity is still debated.

long_description.id: Binatang Gévaudan adalah nama untuk satu atau lebih pemangsa manusia yang meneror Gévaudan di Pegunungan Margeride, Prancis, sejak 30 Juni 1764; korban resmi pertamanya Jeanne Boulet, 14 tahun. Saksi menggambarkannya cokelat kemerahan bergaris gelap, sebesar anak sapi, berekor panjang berjumbai, dan bergerak seolah terbang; artikel bahasa Jepang menyebut ia sering menyasar kepala korban. Sebuah kajian tahun 1987 menghitung 210 serangan dan 113 korban tewas.
long_description.en: The Beast of Gévaudan is the name for one or more man-eaters that terrorised Gévaudan in the Margeride Mountains of France from 30 June 1764; its first official victim was 14-year-old Jeanne Boulet. Witnesses described it as russet with dark stripes, calf-sized, with a long tufted tail, moving as if flying; the Japanese article says it often went for the head. A 1987 study counted 210 attacks and 113 deaths.

long_description.id: Kerajaan Prancis mengerahkan bangsawan, tentara, dan pemburu kerajaan untuk memburunya, dan beberapa binatang dibunuh sebelum serangan berhenti, meski saksi menyebut ia berkali-kali terluka tanpa mati. Identitasnya, dubuk, serigala, anjing besar, atau anjing-serigala, masih diperdebatkan, dan sumber berbeda soal akhir masa serangan (1767 atau 1770).
long_description.en: The Kingdom of France sent nobles, soldiers and royal huntsmen after it, and several animals were killed before the attacks ceased, though witnesses said it was wounded many times without dying. Its identity, hyena, wolf, big dog or wolfdog, is still debated, and sources differ on when the attacks ended (1767 or 1770).

short_description.id: Erdhenne ("ayam betina tanah") adalah roh rumah dalam cerita rakyat Jerman dari kawasan Alpen, Oberpfalz, dan Bayern yang berkotek untuk memperingatkan penghuni rumah akan bahaya.
short_description.en: The Erdhenne ('earth hen') is a house spirit of German folklore from the Alp region, the Upper Palatinate and Bavaria that clucks to warn a household of danger.

long_description.id: Erdhenne, yang juga disebut Erdhühnlein, Erdglucke, Erdglutsch, Herdhendl, atau Coluber domesticus, adalah roh rumah dari cerita rakyat Jerman di kawasan Alpen, Oberpfalz, dan Bayern. Suaranya konon terdengar dari dalam tanah atau sudut gelap ruangan, mirip kotek induk ayam yang menuntun anak-anaknya, dan dari situlah namanya berasal.
long_description.en: The Erdhenne, also called Erdhühnlein, Erdglucke, Erdglutsch, Herdhendl or Coluber domesticus, is a house spirit of German folklore in the Alp region, the Upper Palatinate and Bavaria. Its voice is said to come out of the ground or a dark corner of the room, like a mother hen leading her chicks, which is how it got its name.

long_description.id: Seperti katak Unke atau ular rumah, Erdhenne dianggap roh pelindung yang baik hati. Biasanya ia tak terlihat dan hanya berkotek keras untuk memperingatkan penghuni akan bahaya yang mengancam mereka atau rumah; menurut beberapa legenda, ia bahkan menjawab pertanyaan tentang bahaya itu bila ditanya langsung.
long_description.en: Like the Unke toad or the house snake, the Erdhenne is held to be a kindly guardian spirit. Usually unseen, it just clucks loudly to warn the household of dangers threatening them or the house; some legends say it will even answer questions about the danger if asked directly.

long_description.id: Bila menampakkan diri, ia berupa ayam betina tua berbulu kusut kelabu abu dengan leher pendek, dan kemunculannya meramalkan kematian dalam setahun, biasanya orang yang melihatnya. Menurut legenda lain, bila ia berkotek dan mengepakkan sayap sembilan kali, kepala rumah tangga akan jatuh sakit parah.
long_description.en: When it does show itself it looks like an old, shaggy, ash-grey hen with a short neck, and its appearance foretells a death within the year, usually of whoever sees it. Another legend says that if it clucks and flaps its wings nine times, the head of the house will fall mortally ill.

long_description.id: Kepercayaan ini sudah lama diolok-olok. I. G. Schmidt dalam kumpulan takhayulnya tahun 1718 mengaku pernah menangkap "Erd-Hüngen" di gudang bawah tanah yang ternyata hanya seekor tikus, dan Johann Andreas Schmeller dalam Bayerisches Wörterbuch menganggapnya hasil salah tafsir cahaya bulan yang masuk lewat kaca jendela bulat.
long_description.en: The belief has long been mocked. In his 1718 collection of superstitions I. G. Schmidt claimed to have caught an 'Erd-Hüngen' in a cellar that turned out to be a mere mouse, and Johann Andreas Schmeller in his Bayerisches Wörterbuch put it down to moonlight misread as it shone through round-paned windows.

short_description.id: Each-uisge ("kuda air") adalah roh air dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia dan Skotlandia, biasanya berwujud kuda, mirip kelpie tetapi jauh lebih ganas.
short_description.en: The each-uisge ('water horse') is a water spirit of Irish and Scottish folklore, usually horse-shaped, like the kelpie but far more vicious.

long_description.id: Each-uisge (Gaelik Skotlandia/Scottish Gaelic, harfiah "kuda air") adalah roh air dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish) dan Skotlandia (Scottish), dieja each-uisce (dianglisisasi aughisky atau ech-ushkya) di Irlandia (Ireland) dan cabbyl-ushtey di Isle of Man. Biasanya berwujud kuda, mirip kelpie tetapi jauh lebih ganas. Folklorist Katharine Briggs menyebutnya mungkin yang paling ganas dan berbahaya di antara semua kuda air. Berbeda dengan kelpie yang menghuni sungai, each-uisge tinggal di laut dan danau (loch) air asin maupun tawar di Dataran Tinggi Skotlandia (Scottish Highlands).
long_description.en: The each-uisge (Scottish Gaelic, literally 'water horse') is a water spirit of Irish and Scottish folklore, known on the Isle of Man as cabbyl-ushtey and in Ireland as each-uisce, anglicised as aughisky or ech-ushkya. Most often in horse shape, it resembles the kelpie but is much more savage. The folklorist Katharine Briggs judged it perhaps the fiercest and deadliest of all water-horses. Unlike the kelpie, which keeps to streams and rivers, it lives in the sea and in salt and freshwater lochs of the Scottish Highlands.

long_description.id: Each-uisge berubah wujud menjadi kuda atau kuda poni yang bagus, lelaki tampan, atau burung raksasa. Bila seseorang menungganginya, ia hanya aman selama berada di daratan; begitu makhluk itu melihat atau mencium air, kulitnya menjadi lengket dan ia membawa korbannya ke bagian danau yang paling dalam, lalu mencabik dan memakan seluruh tubuhnya kecuali hati, yang mengapung ke permukaan. Dalam wujud manusia ia hanya dapat dikenali dari rumput air atau pasir dan lumpur di rambutnya. Menurut artikel de, each-uisge dianggap salah satu monster air paling berbahaya dalam dunia legenda Kelt Skotlandia (schottisch-keltischen Sagenwelt).
long_description.en: The each-uisge changes into a fine horse or pony, a handsome man or a huge bird. A rider is safe only while it stays inland; once it sees or smells water its skin grows sticky and it carries the victim to the deepest part of the loch, then rips the body apart and eats all of it except the liver, which floats up. In human shape it can be known only by water weed or sand and mud in its hair. According to the de article, it counts among the most dangerous water monsters of the Scottish-Celtic legend world (schottisch-keltischen Sagenwelt).

long_description.id: Kisah menggambarkannya sebagai hewan baik yang muncul pada pemerintahan penguasa berbudi. Zouyu berwajah garang seperti harimau, tetapi lembut dan hanya memakan tumbuhan. long_description.en: Accounts describe it as a righteous animal appearing under a benevolent ruler. Zouyu appears fierce like a tiger but is gentle and strictly vegetarian. In 1404, Zhu Su sent a creature described as Zouyu to the Yongle Emperor. Some modern authors propose the giant panda as the animal identified as Zouyu.

claims.quote: The zouyu (Chinese: 騶虞; pinyin: zōu yú), also called zouwu (騶吾; zōu wú) or zouya (騶牙; zōu yá), is a legendary creature mentioned in old Chinese literature.

short_description.id: Otso adalah roh kolektif seluruh beruang dalam mitologi Finlandia, raja suci para hewan dan pemimpin hutan yang namanya tidak boleh disebut langsung.
short_description.en: Otso is the collective spirit of all bears in Finnish mythology, sacred king of animals and leader of the forest, whose true name must never be spoken.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Finlandia, Otso adalah beruang, raja suci para hewan dan pemimpin hutan, yang sangat ditakuti dan dihormati suku-suku Finlandia kuno. Ia bukan roh seekor beruang tertentu, melainkan roh kolektif seluruh beruang. Nama-nama seperti Otso ("si dahi lebar"), Kontio, Metsän kuningas ("raja hutan"), dan Mesikämmen ("cakar madu") adalah sebutan kiasan, karena roh beruang tidak boleh disebut namanya secara langsung.
long_description.en: In Finnish mythology Otso is a bear revered as the holy king of the animals who leads the forest, greatly feared and honoured by the old Finnish tribes. He is not a particular bear's spirit but the collective spirit of all bears. Names such as Otso ("broad forehead"), Kontio, Metsän kuningas ("king of the forest") and Mesikämmen ("honey paw") are circumlocutions, because the bear spirit must never be named directly.

long_description.id: Asal-usul Otso dikisahkan berbeda-beda: sebagian kisah menyebut ia lahir dari wol yang dilempar dewa cuaca Ukko ke laut, kisah lain dari rasi Biduk. Mitos tertua menceritakan pernikahannya dengan ibu purba seluruh manusia, yang tercermin dalam ritual Peijaiset: bila beruang dibunuh, tengkoraknya dipasang di pohon pinus dan rohnya secara simbolis dikembalikan kepada keluarganya.
long_description.en: Otso's origin is told in different ways: some stories say he was born from wool that the weather god Ukko threw into the sea, others from the Ursa Major constellation. The oldest myths tell of his marriage to the primordial mother of all people, reflected in the Peijaiset ritual: when a bear was killed its skull was mounted on a pine and its spirit symbolically returned to its family.

long_description.id: Nyanyian suci pemujaan beruang dikenal pada banyak bangsa Fino-Ugria, dari Finlandia hingga Khanty dan Mansi. Otso muncul dalam epos Kalevala, beruang menjadi hewan nasional Finlandia, dan Otso juga dipuja dalam neopaganisme Finlandia modern.
long_description.en: Sacred bear-cult songs are known among many Finno-Ugric peoples, from the Finns to the Khanty and Mansi. Otso appears in the Kalevala epic, the bear is Finland's national animal, and Otso is also worshipped in modern Finnish neopaganism.

cultural_context.id: Beruang adalah hewan paling dihormati dalam kepercayaan Finlandia kuno; ritual Peijaiset mengembalikan roh beruang yang dibunuh kepada keluarganya.
cultural_context.en: The bear was the most revered animal in old Finnish belief; the Peijaiset ritual returned the spirit of a killed bear to its family.

claims.quote: In Finnish mythology, Otso (also known as Karhu, Ohto, Kontio, Metsän kuningas, and Mesikämmen) is a bear, the sacred king of animals and leader of the forest. It was deeply feared and respected by old Finnish tribes. Otso appears in the Finnish national epic, the Kalevala.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Finlandia, Otso (juga Karhu, Ohto, Kontio, Metsän kuningas, dan Mesikämmen) adalah beruang, raja suci para hewan dan pemimpin hutan, yang sangat ditakuti dan dihormati suku-suku Finlandia kuno, dan ia muncul dalam epos nasional Kalevala.
statement.en: In Finnish mythology Otso (also Karhu, Ohto, Kontio, Metsän kuningas and Mesikämmen) is a bear, the sacred king of animals and leader of the forest, deeply feared and respected by old Finnish tribes, and he appears in the national epic Kalevala.

statement.id: Otso bukan roh seekor beruang tertentu, melainkan roh animistis kolektif seluruh beruang.
statement.en: Otso is not a particular bear's spirit but the collective animistic spirit of all bears.

claims.quote: Some stories tell of how Ukko, the god of weather, threw wool into the sea and how Otso was born from the bits of wool that reached the shore. Other stories tell of how Otso was born from the Ursa Major constellation.

statement.id: Sebagian kisah menyebut Ukko, dewa cuaca, melemparkan wol ke laut dan Otso lahir dari serpihan wol yang terdampar di pantai; kisah lain menyebut Otso lahir dari rasi bintang Biduk (Ursa Major).
statement.en: Some stories tell that Ukko, the weather god, threw wool into the sea and Otso was born from the bits of wool that reached the shore; others say Otso was born from the Ursa Major constellation.

claims.quote: The most ancient myths surrounding Otso tell of the marriage between Otso and the primordial mother of all men. This relationship was reflected in the ritual of Peijaiset, in which the bear spirit was symbolically returned to its family through marriage.

statement.id: Mitos tertua tentang Otso mengisahkan pernikahan Otso dengan ibu purba seluruh manusia, yang tercermin dalam ritual Peijaiset, ketika roh beruang secara simbolis dikembalikan kepada keluarganya melalui pernikahan.
statement.en: The oldest myths about Otso tell of his marriage to the primordial mother of all people, reflected in the Peijaiset ritual, in which the bear spirit was symbolically returned to its family through marriage.

claims.quote: If a bear had to be killed by ancient Finns, a sacred ritual of Peijaiset was held. In it, the bear's skull was mounted on a pine tree.

statement.id: Bila orang Finlandia kuno terpaksa membunuh beruang, diadakan ritual suci Peijaiset, di mana tengkorak beruang dipasang di pohon pinus.
statement.en: If the ancient Finns had to kill a bear, a sacred Peijaiset ritual was held, in which the bear's skull was mounted on a pine tree.

claims.quote: Besides being worshipped by historical Finnish pagans, Otso is also worshipped in modern Finnish neopaganism, and the neopagan organization Karhun kansa is named after the bear.

statement.id: Selain dipuja kaum pagan Finlandia di masa lalu, Otso juga dipuja dalam neopaganisme Finlandia modern, dan organisasi neopagan Karhun kansa dinamai menurut beruang.
statement.en: Besides being worshipped by historical Finnish pagans, Otso is also worshipped in modern Finnish neopaganism, and the neopagan organisation Karhun kansa is named after the bear.

short_description.id: Henwen ("Si Tua Putih") adalah babi betina dalam legenda Wales yang menurut Welsh Triads melahirkan Cath Palug serta gandum, lebah, serigala, dan elang.
short_description.en: Henwen ('Old White') is a sow of Welsh legend who, by the Welsh Triads, gave birth to Cath Palug as well as wheat, bees, a wolf and an eagle.

long_description.id: Henwen, yang berarti "Si Tua Putih" (Old White), adalah babi betina dalam legenda Wales (Welsh) yang menurut Welsh Triads melahirkan Cath Palug, kucing raksasa yang dilawan Cai (Sir Kay) atau Raja Arthur (King Arthur). Menurut triad "Three Powerful Swineherds of the Isle of Britain", babi itu dipelihara oleh Coll putra Collfrewy, penggembala babi Dallwyr Dallben, di Lembah Dallwyr di Cornwall. Babi itu akan melahirkan, tetapi menurut nubuat hal itu pertanda buruk bagi Pulau Britania, sehingga ia dikejar sampai terjun ke laut di Penrhyn Awstin, Cornwall, lalu muncul lagi di Aber Tarogi di Gwent Is-coed.
long_description.en: Henwen, meaning 'Old White', is a sow of Welsh legend who, by the Welsh Triads, bore Cath Palug, the monstrous cat fought by Cai (Sir Kay) or King Arthur. In the triad 'Three Powerful Swineherds of the Isle of Britain' she was kept by Coll son of Collfrewy, swineherd to Dallwyr Dallben, in the Glen of Dallwyr in Cornwall. She was about to give birth, which prophecy said boded ill for the Isle of Britain, so she was hunted until she leapt into the waves off Penrhyn Awstin in Cornwall, landing again at Aber Tarogi in Gwent Is-coed.

long_description.id: Di berbagai tempat ia kemudian melahirkan keturunan, sebagian membawa berkah dan sebagian bencana: sebutir gandum dan seekor lebah di Maes Gwenith, Gwent; jelai dan lebah di Llonion; anak serigala dan anak elang di bukit Cyferthwch, Snowdonia; dan seekor anak kucing di bawah Batu Hitam di Llanfair, Arfon, yang dibuang ke Selat Menai dan menjadi Cath Palug. Don Carleton menduga kisah Henwen adalah alegori perburuan Arthur terhadap seorang pemimpin agama perempuan. Menurut artikel fr, Henwen juga diartikan "Leluhur Suci", dan ia membawa jelai dan gandum hitam ke Wales.
long_description.en: She then bore offspring in various places, some a blessing and some a bane: a grain of wheat and a bee at Maes Gwenith in Gwent; barley and a bee at Llonion; a wolf-cub and an eaglet on the hill of Cyferthwch in Snowdonia; and a kitten under the Black Rock at Llanfair in Arfon, cast into the Menai Strait, which became Cath Palug. Don Carleton suggests the Henwen tale is an allegory of Arthur harrying a female religious leader. According to the fr article Henwen is also glossed 'the Sacred Ancestor', and she brought barley and rye to Wales.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Welsh Triads, Henwen melahirkan sebutir gandum dan seekor lebah di Gwent, tetapi juga anak serigala, anak elang, dan anak kucing yang menjadi Cath Palug.
did_you_know.en: The Welsh Triads say Henwen bore a grain of wheat and a bee in Gwent, but also a wolf-cub, an eaglet and the kitten that became Cath Palug.

note.en: Monstrous cat she bore.

short_description.id: Feldgeister ("roh ladang") atau Korndämonen ("setan gandum") adalah roh-roh pertanian dalam cerita rakyat Jerman yang menghuni ladang gandum, berwujud hewan atau manusia.
short_description.en: Feldgeister ('field spirits') or Korndämonen ('corn demons') are agricultural spirits of German folklore who inhabit the grain fields in animal or human form.

long_description.id: Feldgeister atau Korndämonen adalah roh gandum dalam cerita rakyat Jerman, dan sering juga roh angin yang mendatangkan kilat dan hujan. Istilah Korndämonen diperkenalkan Wilhelm Mannhardt sebagai sebutan kolektif bagi makhluk gaib di ladang gandum atau tanaman lain seperti rami, kacang, dan opium; menurut artikel bahasa Jerman, sebutan "Korngeist" sebenarnya lebih tepat.
long_description.en: Feldgeister or Korndämonen are corn spirits of German folklore, and often also wind spirits that bring lightning and rain. The term Korndämonen was coined by Wilhelm Mannhardt as a collective name for supernatural beings in grain fields or other crops such as flax, beans and poppies; the German article notes that 'Korngeist' would really be the better label.

long_description.id: Feldgeister dikenal dalam banyak bentuk, ada yang berwujud hewan seperti serigala gandum (Roggenwolf), anjing, kucing, babi, kambing, dan ayam jantan, ada pula yang berwujud manusia seperti Roggenmuhme, Hafermann, dan Kornkind. Banyak di antaranya ditakuti karena mencuri atau menyakiti anak-anak; kehadiran setan gandum terlihat pada gandum yang bergelombang, seperti dalam ungkapan "Ibu Gandum ada di ladang".
long_description.en: Feldgeister come in many shapes: animal forms such as the rye wolf (Roggenwolf), dogs, cats, pigs, goats and roosters, and human forms such as the Roggenmuhme, the Hafermann and the Kornkind. Many are feared for stealing or harming children; a corn demon's presence is seen in the waving of the grain, as in the saying 'the Corn Mother is in the field'.

long_description.id: Saat panen, roh-roh itu lari makin dalam ke ladang menghindari para penyabit dan akhirnya terperangkap di batang gandum terakhir. Ia lalu dibunuh dengan dipotong atau diirik, atau dibawa ke desa dengan upacara dalam wujud boneka gandum; bulir terakhir dan buah pohon sering ditinggalkan sebagai persembahan. Sentuhan langsung dengan roh ladang menyebabkan sakit.
long_description.en: At harvest the spirits flee deeper into the field away from the mowers and are finally trapped in the last stalks. The spirit is then killed by cutting or threshing, or carried ceremonially to the village as a corn doll; the last ears and tree fruits are often left as an offering. Direct contact with a field spirit brings illness.

long_description.id: Korndämonen dianggap berasal dari dewa-dewa tumbuhan bangsa petani yang dahulu dipuja untuk melindungi tanaman. Seiring waktu makna aslinya hilang dan mereka didemonisasi, menjadi sosok menakutkan yang mencegah anak-anak memasuki dan merusak ladang yang sedang matang. Konsep roh gandum dipopulerkan pada awal abad ke-20 oleh antropolog Inggris James Frazer.
long_description.en: Korndämonen are thought to stem from the vegetation gods of farming peoples, once worshipped to protect the crops. Over time their original meaning faded and they were demonised into bogeys that kept children from entering and trampling the ripening fields. The idea of the corn spirit was popularised in the early 20th century by the British anthropologist James Frazer.

role.en: Trapped in the last stalks of grain.

famous_for.id: Menakut-nakuti anak agar tak masuk ladang.
famous_for.en: Scares children away from the fields.

did_you_know.id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, roh ladang terperangkap di batang gandum terakhir yang dipanen, lalu dibawa ke desa dalam wujud boneka gandum.
did_you_know.en: Folk belief held that the field spirit was trapped in the last stalks harvested and carried to the village as a corn doll.

Either it is killed by cutting the grain heads, threshing the corn or it is brought to the village in a ceremonial manner, shaped as a corn doll. Direct contact to the Feldgeist causes illness.

statement.en: Feldgeister (Feldgeist, Korndämonen) are corn spirits of German folklore, often also wind spirits; at harvest they flee deeper into the field, are trapped in the last stalks, then killed by cutting or threshing, or brought ceremonially to the village as a corn doll; direct contact causes illness.

statement.en: Many Feldgeister are known in German folklore, some animal-shaped, some human; the last ears of grain and tree fruits are often left in place as an offering.

short_description.id: Heimchen adalah makhluk dari cerita rakyat Jerman (German folklore) dengan beberapa makna yang saling berkaitan: jangkrik rumah, kurcaci kecil, dan arwah anak-anak dalam rombongan Perchta.
short_description.en: The Heimchen is a being from German folklore with several related meanings: the house cricket, tiny dwarf-like folk, and child souls in the train of Perchta.

long_description.id: Heimchen (bentuk kecil dari Heim, rumah) pada dasarnya adalah sebutan Jerman untuk jangkrik rumah. Jangkrik rumah merupakan salah satu wujud hewan yang diambil para kurcaci, sebagaimana tampak dari nama-nama dialek seperti Herdschmiedl (pandai besi perapian) dan Heunemänken. Di North Palatinate dan Western Palatinate jangkrik itu, yang di sana disebut Krikelmaus, dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak; di Pomerania, Heimchen justru memberi makan anak yang tersesat dengan roti dan susu; di Silesia, derik jangkrik rumah menandakan hadirnya arwah orang mati. Dalam kepercayaan rakyat, jangkrik di dalam rumah juga dianggap pembawa keberuntungan.
long_description.en: Heimchen (a diminutive of Heim, home) is first of all the German word for the house cricket. The house cricket is one of the animal forms dwarves take, as dialect names such as Herdschmiedl (hearth smith) and Heunemänken show. In North Palatinate and Western Palatinate the cricket, called Krikelmaus there, is a bogey to frighten children; in Pomerania the Heimchen instead feed lost children with bread rolls and milk; in Silesia the chirping house cricket signals that a dead soul is present. In folk belief a cricket in the house was also held to bring luck.

long_description.id: Di Vogtland, Heimchen adalah makhluk kecil yang tingginya tak sampai dua kaki. Mereka tinggal di padang luas di dalam gua gunung yang terang seperti siang karena sebutir batu karbunkel besar. Pintu masuknya tidak selalu terbuka, dan Heimchen, yang menyebut diri Bergvolk, tidak selalu terlihat oleh mata manusia. Mereka menggembalakan domba emas sebesar anak domba, dijaga Ilsa, gadis berbaju putih yang terkena sihir dan menanti penebusannya.
long_description.en: In the Vogtland the Heimchen are small beings not even two feet tall. They live on a wide meadow inside a mountain cave made bright as day by a large carbuncle stone. The entrance is not always open, and the Heimchen, who call themselves Bergvolk, cannot always be seen by human eyes. They herd golden sheep the size of lambs, tended by Ilsa, a white-clad enchanted girl awaiting her release.

long_description.id: Menurut cerita rakyat Thuringia, Heimchen adalah arwah anak-anak yang belum dibaptis dan meratap, yang mengikuti Perchta sebagai pemimpin mereka; dalam satu kisah setempat Perchta disebut Heimchenkönigin. Di Orlagau, mereka juga disebut Heimele, Butzelmännchen, dan Erdmännele, roh tanah setinggi satu jari yang tinggal di lubang tikus di rumah. Mereka memberi tanda lebih dahulu apakah penghuni rumah akan beruntung atau sial, kadang meninggalkan hadiah bila dirawat dengan baik, dan diam-diam membantu manusia mengurus ladang, ternak, atau anak yang ditinggal orang tuanya.
long_description.en: In the lore of Thuringia the Heimchen are the wailing souls of unbaptized children, who follow Perchta as their leader; one local tale calls her Heimchenkönigin. In the Orlagau they are also called Heimele, Butzelmännchen and Erdmännele, earth spirits a finger tall living in the mouse holes of houses. They foretell whether the household will have good or bad luck, sometimes leave gifts if treated well, and secretly help people with fields, cattle or children left alone by their parents.

long_description.id: Sebuah legenda menceritakan bahwa Heimchen dahulu rajin membantu petani di desa-desa Orlagau hingga daerah itu sangat makmur. Lalu datang seorang lelaki dari jauh yang berkata bahwa Perchta tak dapat dipercaya karena Heimchen adalah arwah anak yang belum dibaptis. Ketika orang-orang mulai menjauhi mereka, Perchta memutuskan pergi, dan ia bersama Heimchen menyeberangi sungai dan tak pernah kembali.
long_description.en: One legend tells that the Heimchen once worked hard for the farmers of the Orlagau villages, making the area very rich. Then a man came from far away and said Perchta could not be trusted, because the Heimchen were the souls of unbaptized children. When people began to shun them, Perchta chose to leave, and she and the Heimchen crossed the stream and never came back.

claims.quote: The Heimchen ... is a being from German folklore with several related meanings.

statement.id: Heimchen adalah makhluk dari cerita rakyat Jerman dengan beberapa makna yang saling berkaitan.
statement.en: The Heimchen is a being from German folklore with several related meanings.

claims.quote: In the first place, Heimchen (diminutive of Heim = home) is the German term for house cricket. The house cricket is one of the animal appearances taken by dwarves, as is also attested by the dialectal names such as Herdschmiedl (hearth smith) and Heunemänken (Mänken = manikin).

statement.id: Heimchen (dari Heim, rumah) adalah sebutan Jerman untuk jangkrik rumah, salah satu wujud hewan kurcaci; nama dialeknya antara lain Herdschmiedl dan Heunemänken.
statement.en: Heimchen (from Heim, home) is the German term for the house cricket, one of the animal forms of dwarves; dialect names include Herdschmiedl and Heunemänken.

claims.quote: In North Palatinate and Western Palatinate, the house cricket, there known as Krikelmaus (Maus = mouse), is a nursery bogey used to scare children.

statement.id: Di North Palatinate dan Western Palatinate, jangkrik rumah yang disebut Krikelmaus dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak.
statement.en: In North and Western Palatinate the house cricket, called Krikelmaus, is a nursery bogey to scare children.

claims.quote: In Pomerania, the Heimchen feed lost children with bread rolls and milk instead.

statement.id: Di Pomerania, Heimchen memberi makan anak yang tersesat dengan roti dan susu.
statement.en: In Pomerania the Heimchen feed lost children with bread rolls and milk.

claims.quote: In Silesia, the stridulating house cricket indicates the presence of a deceased soul.

statement.id: Di Silesia, derik jangkrik rumah menandakan hadirnya arwah orang mati.
statement.en: In Silesia the chirping house cricket indicates a deceased soul is present.

claims.quote: In the Vogtland, the Heimchen are little beings, nary two feet tall, who dwell on a great meadow inside a mountain cave lit as bright as day by a big carbuncle gem.

statement.id: Di Vogtland, Heimchen adalah makhluk kecil yang tingginya tak sampai dua kaki, tinggal di padang dalam gua gunung yang diterangi batu karbunkel.
statement.en: In the Vogtland the Heimchen are little beings under two feet tall living on a meadow inside a mountain cave lit by a carbuncle gem.

claims.quote: The entrance is not always open, and the Heimchen or Bergvolk (mountain folk), as they call themselves, are not always visible to human eyes. Those Heimchen keep golden sheep no bigger than lambs whose shepherdess, Ilsa, is an enchanted girl dressed in white with a golden shepherd's staff who is waiting for her redemption.

statement.id: Heimchen atau Bergvolk tidak selalu terlihat oleh mata manusia; mereka memelihara domba emas yang digembalakan Ilsa, gadis tersihir berbaju putih.
statement.en: The Heimchen or Bergvolk are not always visible to human eyes; they keep golden sheep herded by Ilsa, an enchanted girl in white.

claims.quote: The Heimchen are imagined to be the wailing souls of unbaptized children, accompanying Perchta as their leader, according to the lore of Thuringia

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat Thuringia, Heimchen adalah arwah anak-anak belum dibaptis yang mengikuti Perchta sebagai pemimpinnya.
statement.en: In Thuringian lore the Heimchen are the wailing souls of unbaptized children following Perchta as their leader.

claims.quote: She is called Heimchenkönigin, i.e. Heimchen-Queen in one local tale. There is also a belief that a stridulating Heimchen or house cricket sits on the nose of Percht.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah setempat Perchta disebut Heimchenkönigin (ratu Heimchen); ada juga kepercayaan bahwa seekor Heimchen berderik duduk di hidung Percht.
statement.en: In one local tale she is called Heimchenkönigin (Heimchen-Queen); a belief also holds that a chirping Heimchen sits on the nose of Percht.

claims.quote: In the Orlagau in Thuringia the Heimchen, who are also called Heimele, Butzelmännchen (little bogeymen), and Erdmännele (earth manikins), are thought of as tiny earth spirits, as tall as a finger is long, who dwell in the mouse holes of houses.

statement.id: Di Orlagau, Thuringia, Heimchen, juga disebut Heimele, Butzelmännchen, dan Erdmännele, dianggap roh tanah setinggi jari yang tinggal di lubang tikus rumah.
statement.en: In the Orlagau in Thuringia the Heimchen, also called Heimele, Butzelmännchen and Erdmännele, are tiny finger-tall earth spirits living in the mouse holes of houses.

claims.quote: They indicate beforehand whether the house dwellers will meet good or bad luck and, if well taken care of, at times might also place gifts in front of their mouse hole in the morning.

statement.id: Mereka memberi tanda lebih dahulu apakah penghuni rumah akan beruntung atau sial, dan bila dirawat baik kadang meninggalkan hadiah.
statement.en: They indicate in advance whether the house dwellers will meet good or bad luck and, if well cared for, sometimes leave gifts.

claims.quote: The friendly, childishly gay, playful little dwarves love to help humans unseen, be it that they tend to fields and cattle or keep watch on children whose parents are absent.

statement.id: Kurcaci kecil yang ramah itu suka membantu manusia tanpa terlihat, mengurus ladang dan ternak atau menjaga anak yang ditinggal orang tuanya.
statement.en: The friendly little dwarves like to help humans unseen, tending fields and cattle or watching children whose parents are away.

claims.quote: One day, though, a serious man came from afar who told the people that Perchta isn't to be trusted as the Heimchen are the souls of unbaptized children. When the people then avoided the Heimchen, Perchta decided that it was time to leave, and she and the Heimchen crossed the stream never to return again.

statement.id: Seorang lelaki dari jauh berkata Perchta tak dapat dipercaya karena Heimchen arwah anak belum dibaptis; ketika warga menjauhi Heimchen, Perchta dan Heimchen menyeberangi sungai dan tak kembali.
statement.en: A man from afar said Perchta was not to be trusted since the Heimchen were souls of unbaptized children; when people shunned the Heimchen, Perchta and the Heimchen crossed the stream and never returned.

claims.quote: Im Volksglauben galt die Grille im Haus als Glücksbringer.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan rakyat (Volksglauben), jangkrik (Grille) di dalam rumah dianggap pembawa keberuntungan (Glücksbringer).
statement.en: In folk belief (Volksglauben) the cricket (Grille) in the house was held to be a bringer of luck (Glücksbringer).

claims.quote: Das Heimchen (Acheta domesticus), auch Hausgrille, ist eine Langfühlerschrecke aus der Familie der Echten Grillen (Gryllidae).

statement.id: Heimchen (Acheta domesticus), juga disebut Hausgrille, adalah serangga dari famili jangkrik sejati (Gryllidae).
statement.en: The Heimchen (Acheta domesticus), also called Hausgrille, is an insect of the true cricket family (Gryllidae).

short_description.id: Naga adalah kelompok makhluk ilahi atau setengah ilahi berbentuk manusia dan ular dalam tradisi Asia.
short_description.en: Nagas are a class of divine or semidivine human and serpent beings in Asian traditions.

long_description.id: Naga adalah kelompok makhluk ilahi atau setengah ilahi berbentuk manusia dan ular dalam tradisi Asia. Tempat tinggalnya disebut Patala, alam bawah.
long_description.en: Nagas are a class of divine or semidivine human and serpent beings in Asian traditions. Their dwelling is called Patala, the netherworld.

long_description.id: Mereka dapat tampil sebagai manusia, ular, atau makhluk campuran manusia dan ular. Naga perempuan disebut Nagini. Kashyapa dan Kadru disebut sebagai orang tua kelompok ini dalam legenda. Nagaraja adalah gelar raja para naga. Kisah mereka penting dalam tradisi Hindu dan Buddha di Asia Selatan serta Tenggara. Naga dalam Sanskerta terutama berarti ular, sering kali kobra India. Naga menonjol dalam ikonografi Hindu dan buku pertama Mahabharata. Alam Naga-loka digambarkan berisi permata, emas, dan harta bumi. Naga dikaitkan dengan sungai, danau, laut, dan sumur serta peran penjaga harta. Vishnu digambarkan berbaring pada Shesha atau dilindungi tudungnya. Di India Selatan, sarang rayap dianggap tempat tinggal nagamma perempuan. Mackenzie membahas naga sebagai setengah dewa yang kadang membantu manusia dan memberi minuman penambah kekuatan dalam cerita. Museum Cleveland menjelaskan pentingnya naga bagi pemuja lokal sebagai pengendali air yang menunjang kemakmuran.
long_description.en: They can appear as humans, serpents, or mixed human and serpent beings. A female naga is called Nagini. Kashyapa and Kadru are called this class's parents in legend. Nagaraja is the title of the king of nagas. Their narratives are important in Hindu and Buddhist traditions in South and Southeast Asia. Naga in Sanskrit primarily means snake, often the Indian cobra. Nagas are prominent in Hindu iconography and the first book of the Mahabharata. Naga-loka is described as containing gems, gold, and earthly treasures. Nagas are associated with rivers, lakes, seas, and wells and with guarding treasure. Vishnu is depicted reclining on Shesha or sheltered by his hood. In South India, termite hills are regarded as dwellings of female nagammas. Mackenzie discusses nagas as demigods who sometimes aid humans and give strength enhancing drinks in stories. The Cleveland Museum explains the importance of nagas to local worshippers as controllers of water supporting prosperity.

short_description.id: Kelpie adalah roh mitos berubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia yang menghuni danau, biasanya berwujud kuda kelabu atau putih yang dapat menjadi manusia.
short_description.en: The kelpie is a mythical shapeshifting spirit of Scottish folklore that haunts lochs, usually a grey or white horse able to take human form.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia (Scottish folklore), kelpie atau water kelpie adalah roh mitos yang dapat berubah wujud dan menghuni loch (danau) di Skotlandia; ia juga menghuni danau kecil dan sungai dalam mitologi Yorkshire. Legenda kuda air berubah wujud dengan berbagai nama tersebar di seluruh Kepulauan Britania. Kelpie biasanya digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip kuda berwarna kelabu atau putih yang dapat berwujud manusia; sebagian kisah menyebut ia tetap berkuku saat menjadi manusia, sehingga dikaitkan dengan Setan, seperti disinggung Robert Burns dalam puisi "Address to the Devil" (1786).
long_description.en: In Scottish folklore the kelpie, or water kelpie, is a mythical shapeshifting spirit living in Scotland's lochs; it also haunts meres and streams in Yorkshire mythology. Tales of shape-changing water horses under many names spread across the British Isles. The kelpie is usually a grey or white horse-like creature that can take human form; some accounts say it keeps its hooves in human shape, which linked it with Satan, as Robert Burns hints in his 1786 poem "Address to the Devil".

long_description.id: Hampir setiap perairan besar di Skotlandia punya kisah kelpie, tetapi yang paling banyak dilaporkan adalah di Loch Ness. Padanannya di dunia antara lain nixie Jermanik, wihwin dari Amerika Tengah, dan bunyip Australia. Kisah-kisah ini secara praktis berguna untuk menjauhkan anak-anak dari perairan berbahaya dan memperingatkan perempuan muda agar waspada terhadap orang asing yang tampan. Asal kata Skots kelpie tidak pasti, mungkin dari bahasa Gaelik calpa atau cailpeach ("sapi dara" atau "anak kuda"); penggunaan pertamanya untuk makhluk mitos, dengan ejaan kaelpie, terdapat dalam ode William Collins sebelum 1759.
long_description.en: Nearly every sizeable body of water in Scotland has a kelpie tale, but Loch Ness is the most reported. Similar beings elsewhere include the bunyip of Australia, the wihwin of Central America and the nixie of the Germanic peoples. Such stories served to keep children from dangerous waters and to warn young women about handsome strangers. The origin of the Scots word kelpie is unsure, perhaps from Gaelic calpa or cailpeach ("heifer" or "colt"); its first use for the mythical creature, spelled kaelpie, is in an ode by William Collins written before 1759.

long_description.id: Kelpie adalah roh air paling umum dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia. Menurut artikel id, kelpie juga digambarkan dalam seni dan sastra, termasuk dua patung baja setinggi 30 meter di Falkirk, The Kelpies, yang rampung pada Oktober 2013.
long_description.en: The kelpie is the most common water spirit of Scottish folklore. According to the id article it appears in art and literature, including two 30-metre steel sculptures at Falkirk, The Kelpies, finished in October 2013.

short_description.id: Familiar adalah makhluk gaib dalam cerita rakyat Eropa abad pertengahan dan awal modern yang dipercaya melindungi atau membantu penyihir dan dukun dalam sihir dan ramalan, biasanya berwujud hewan.
short_description.en: A familiar is a supernatural entity of medieval and early modern European folklore believed to protect or help witches and cunning folk in magic and divination, usually in animal form.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Eropa (European folklore) abad pertengahan dan awal modern, familiar (tepatnya familiar spirits) dipercaya sebagai makhluk gaib atau penjaga roh yang melindungi atau membantu penyihir dan cunning folk dalam sihir, ramalan, dan wawasan spiritual. Catatan masa itu menyebut familiar dapat muncul dalam banyak wujud, biasanya hewan, kadang manusia, dan digambarkan jelas, tiga dimensi, berwarna, dan bergerak, berbeda dari hantu yang berwujud asap. Familiar penyihir sering dianggap jahat dan digolongkan iblis, sedangkan familiar cunning folk dianggap baik dan lebih sering disebut peri.
long_description.en: In medieval and early modern European folklore, familiars (strictly familiar spirits) were believed to be supernatural beings or spirit guardians that protected or helped witches and cunning folk in magic, divination and spiritual insight. Records of the time say they could take many forms, usually an animal, sometimes a human, and were vivid, three-dimensional, coloured and moving, unlike smoky ghosts. A witch's familiar was often thought malevolent and classed as a demon, while a cunning man's was thought kindly and more often called a fairy.

long_description.id: Tujuan utama familiar adalah melayani penyihir dan melindunginya saat ia mulai memperoleh kekuatannya. Sejak abad ke-20, sebagian praktisi sihir, termasuk penganut Wicca, memakai konsep familiar, memanfaatkan hewan peliharaan atau satwa liar, atau meyakini familiar tak kasatmata sebagai pembantu magis. Menurut artikel de, familiar atau Hexentier adalah makhluk kecil berwujud hewan terutama dalam cerita rakyat Kelt dan Anglo-Saxon; mereka tidak terikat pada rumah dan dapat bepergian bersama pemiliknya, dan sebagian pemburu penyihir melihatnya sebagai wujud iblis atau Setan.
long_description.en: The main purpose of a familiar was to serve the witch and protect her as she came into her powers. Since the 20th century some magic practitioners, including Wiccans, use the idea of familiars, working with pets or wildlife or believing in invisible familiars as magical helpers. According to the de article, the familiar or Hexentier is a small animal-shaped being mainly of Celtic and Anglo-Saxon folklore; it is not bound to a house and can travel with its owner, and some witch-hunters saw it as an earthly form of a demon or the Devil.

short_description.id: Nongshaba adalah dewa singa dalam Sanamahism dan mitologi Meitei.
short_description.en: Nongshaba is a lion god in Sanamahism and Meitei mythology.

long_description.id: Nongshaba adalah dewa singa dalam Sanamahism dan mitologi Meitei. Ia dipandang sebagai raja para dewa.
long_description.en: Nongshaba is a lion god in Sanamahism and Meitei mythology. He is regarded as king of the gods.

long_description.id: Ia dipercaya menghasilkan cahaya primordial dan membuat matahari. Ia dipuja oleh masyarakat klan Ningthouja dan Moirang. Di Moirang ia menjadi dewa garis keturunan dan ayah Thangching. Kangla Sha dianggap representasi ilahinya. Catatan antropologi menyebut Nongshaba sebagai dewa hutan terbesar yang menjadikan putra tunggalnya Thangjing dewa utama Moirang.
long_description.en: He is credited with producing primordial light and making the sun. He is worshipped by people of the Ningthouja and Moirang clans. In Moirang he is a lineage deity and Thangching's father. Kangla Sha is regarded as his divine representation. The anthropological account calls Nongshaba the greatest forest god who makes his only son Thangjing Moirang's chief deity.

note.en: His son in Moirang tradition.

sources.title: Man: A Monthly Record of Anthropological Science, volumes XIII–XIV

short_description.en: Bennu is an Egyptian avian deity associated with the sun, creation and rebirth.

long_description.id: Bennu adalah dewa Mesir berbentuk burung yang berkaitan dengan matahari, penciptaan, dan kelahiran kembali. Ia dikatakan menciptakan diri sendiri dan menjadi ba Ra.
long_description.en: Bennu is an Egyptian avian deity associated with the sun, creation and rebirth. He is said to create himself and be Ra’s ba.

long_description.id: Ia terbang di atas air Nun dan berseru sehingga menentukan penciptaan. Namanya dikaitkan dengan kata wbn, terbit bercahaya atau bersinar. long_description.en: He flies over Nun’s waters and calls out to determine creation. His name is linked with wbn, to rise in brilliance or shine. New Kingdom art depicts him as a great grey heron. The accompanying encyclopedia connects Bennu with the origin of Greek Phoenix legends.

short_description.id: Devil Bird atau Ulama adalah burung legenda Sri Lanka dengan jeritan menyerupai suara manusia pada malam hari.
short_description.en: The Devil Bird or Ulama is a Sri Lankan legendary bird with human sounding night shrieks.

long_description.id: Devil Bird atau Ulama adalah burung legenda Sri Lanka dengan jeritan menyerupai suara manusia pada malam hari. Tangisannya dipercaya menjadi pertanda kematian.
long_description.en: The Devil Bird or Ulama is a Sri Lankan legendary bird with human sounding night shrieks. Its cry is believed to portend death.

long_description.id: Identitas zoologisnya masih diperdebatkan. Burung kandidat mencakup honey buzzard, brown wood owl, dan berbagai elang. Tennent menuturkan versi ibu yang berubah menjadi ulama setelah kehilangan anaknya dan kemudian menjerit pada malam hari. Tennent mengutip Mitford yang menolak identifikasi sebagai burung hantu dan mengaku belum mendapatkan spesimen.
long_description.en: Its zoological identity remains disputed. Candidate birds include the honey buzzard, brown wood owl, and various eagles. Tennent recounts a version of a mother becoming an ulama after losing her child and then shrieking at night. Mitford says the Devil-Bird is no owl and notes rewards have failed to secure a specimen.

sources.title: SKETCHES OF THE NATURAL HISTORY OF CEYLON

short_description.id: Mahishi adalah sosok iblis perempuan dalam mitologi Hindu yang kisahnya berkaitan dengan Ayyappa dan Sabarimala.
short_description.en: Mahishi is a demoness in Hindu mythology whose story concerns Ayyappa and Sabarimala.

long_description.id: Mahishi adalah sosok iblis perempuan dalam mitologi Hindu yang kisahnya berkaitan dengan Ayyappa dan Sabarimala. Sumber ini menyebutnya saudari Mahishasura, iblis berwujud kerbau.
long_description.en: Mahishi is a demoness in Hindu mythology whose story concerns Ayyappa and Sabarimala. This source calls her the sister of the buffalo demon Mahishasura.

long_description.id: Ia menerima anugerah bahwa hanya anak dari persatuan Shiva dan Vishnu yang dapat membunuhnya. Kisah kelahiran Ayyappan menjawab syarat anugerah itu melalui persatuan Shiva dengan Mohini, penjelmaan perempuan Vishnu. Ayyappan menangkap tanduknya dan menjatuhkannya ke bumi dalam pertarungan. Kerala Tourism menjelaskan bahwa misi kelahiran Ayyappa adalah menghapus ancaman Mahishi.
long_description.en: She receives a boon that only a child of Shiva and Vishnu's union can kill her. Ayyappan's birth satisfies that condition through Shiva's union with Mohini, Vishnu's female manifestation. Ayyappan seizes her horns and casts her to Earth during their battle. Kerala Tourism explains Ayyappa's birth mission as eliminating the threat posed by Mahishi.

claims.quote: In Hindu mythology, Mahishi is a powerful demoness whose narrative is central to the origin of Lord Ayyappa and the traditions of the Sabarimala temple. She was the sister of the buffalo-demon Mahishasura.

statement.id: Mahishi adalah sosok iblis perempuan dalam mitologi Hindu yang kisahnya berkaitan dengan Ayyappa dan Sabarimala.
statement.en: Mahishi is a demoness in Hindu mythology whose story concerns Ayyappa and Sabarimala.

statement.en: This source calls her the sister of the buffalo demon Mahishasura.

claims.quote: From Brahma, she secured a specific boon: that she could only be slain by a child born of the union of Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu. Believing such a birth to be biologically impossible, she unleashed a reign of terror, conquering the Svarga and ousting Indra from his throne.

statement.id: Ia menerima anugerah bahwa hanya anak dari persatuan Shiva dan Vishnu yang dapat membunuhnya.
statement.en: She receives a boon that only a child of Shiva and Vishnu's union can kill her.

claims.quote: To counter Mahishi's invincibility, the deities sought a solution. Following the Samudra Manthana , Shiva was captivated by the beauty of Mohini, the female avatar of Vishnu. Their union led to the birth of Ayyappan (also known as Manikandan or Dharma Sastha), the divine child born of two male deities, thereby fulfilling the technical requirements of Mahishi’s boon.

statement.id: Kisah kelahiran Ayyappan menjawab syarat anugerah itu melalui persatuan Shiva dengan Mohini, penjelmaan perempuan Vishnu.
statement.en: Ayyappan's birth satisfies that condition through Shiva's union with Mohini, Vishnu's female manifestation.

claims.quote: When Mahishi attempted to storm heaven once more, Ayyappan, then a young prince, ascended to the celestial realms. He engaged the demoness in a fierce battle, eventually catching her by her horns and hurling her down to Earth. She landed on the banks of the Azhuthayar River near Sabarimala, where Ayyappan performed a divine dance on her body as she died.

statement.id: Ayyappan menangkap tanduknya dan menjatuhkannya ke bumi dalam pertarungan.
statement.en: Ayyappan seizes her horns and casts her to Earth during their battle.
